newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani cotton rates steady amid low demand.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani cotton rates steady amid low demand.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates stayed steady on Tuesday amid selective trade and dealers said a glut of unsold stocks at ginning factories could put prices under pressure in the next few sessions.
"Select buying kept the market steady but overall there is little demand," dealer Mustafa Hussain said. Prices could fall further as stocks with ginners were piling up, he added.
In the kerb, NIAB-78 variety was traded at 2,100 rupees ($52.21), K-68 at 2,150 rupees and MHN-93 at 2,150 rupees per maund (37.32 kg).
